policy: Before any future release, preserve every invariant below and run every testId in REGRESSION_CONTRACT.json. New features must add or update a contract entry instead of silently replacing old behavior.

features.title: Referee match focus / fullscreen
invariants: Start Match may enter match-focus/fullscreen
Manual exit/refocus remains available
Score console must fit the active visual viewport

features.title: Automatic set rotation
invariants: Set 1 -> Set 2 automatically after a valid set win
Set 2 -> Set 3 only when match is 1-1
Never create Set 4
Opening team alternates A-B-A or B-A-B

features.title: Commit completed set before next set
invariants: Completed set is persisted to matches.sets
Next set starts at 0-0
activeMatches and match mirror stay consistent

features.title: Opening server player selection
invariants: At 0-0 the opening server is a real player in court slot 2/even court
Automatic set opening assigns both team and player
Scoring must not be blocked by a missing player after automatic rotation

features.title: Choose opening server -> Start -> score
invariants: Before Set 1 opening server is selected Start is unavailable
After selection but before Start score +/- cannot change score
Only successful Start may enter fullscreen/match focus
Blocked actions show a Vietnamese instruction telling the operator what to do next

features.title: Commentary applause and comeback encouragement
invariants: Tie score may trigger a short applause effect
Set finish triggers medium applause and match finish triggers stronger/longer applause
Upgrade76 must replace Upgrade67 synthetic noise bursts with embedded crowd samples when loaded
Applause uses a dedicated audio path and must not replace or cancel Piper/TTS commentary audio
Operator can enable/disable FX, set FX volume and manually test tie/set/match applause
A team trailing by 5-10 that scores and regains serve may receive encouragement

features.title: Offline crowd applause samples
invariants: Three local OGG multi-layer crowd FX assets exist and decode: tie, set finish, match finish
Tie sample is shortest, set sample medium, match sample longest
Legacy Upgrade67 playApplause delegates to Upgrade76 when Upgrade76 is installed
FX remains available offline through badminton Service Worker cache

features.title: Admin result reset
invariants: Reset to SCHEDULED clears sets winner and finishedAt
Active match is cleared and court is released when applicable
Stale queued score writes are purged
Success is reported only after Firebase read-back confirms reset

features.title: Immutable opening-server ledger
invariants: At first 0-0 of every set store openingServerSide/playerId/playerName
Rally server changes never overwrite the set-opening snapshot
Set 2/3 alternation is based on Set 1 opening snapshot, never the final rally server
Legacy u63 recovery uses the first 0-0 point event when trustworthy

features.title: Responsive referee fullscreen
invariants: Laptop/tablet/phone typography scales to viewport
Portrait phone keeps scoring controls usable
Landscape phone scales primarily by height

features.title: Completed set history strip
invariants: While Set 2 is active show Set 1 result
While Set 3 is active show Set 1 and Set 2 results
Winner labels follow team A/B data, not current left/right court position
Reload can recover committed history from matches.sets

features.title: Automatic Vietnamese voice bootstrap
invariants: Use available vi-VN system voice without downloading TOPKEY model
If no Vietnamese system voice and TOPKEY model is absent, auto-install TOPKEY Offline Voice
Installed model is reused on later visits
Browser autoplay policy is respected; first user gesture unlocks audio when required
Failures are visible to operator and may retry online
Voice bootstrap may prepare/download/warm a voice while the website opens, but it must not by itself authorize commentary playback; Upgrade78 Live Session Gate owns playback permission

features.title: Low-latency commentary pipeline
invariants: Audio prime occurs at most once per browser session
Piper warmup is deduplicated
eventAt survives commentary queue for real point-to-audio latency measurement
Legacy Service Worker registrations are coalesced

features.title: Portrait mobile score visibility
invariants: Both current score values remain fully inside visual viewport
On <=600px portrait, left/right score boxes use equal top-row columns
Center team names move below the score boxes instead of squeezing them
Long team names must wrap/clip before they can push a score outside viewport

features.title: Mandarin pronunciation for Chinese/Hanyu Pinyin player names
invariants: Vietnamese commentary text remains on the Vietnamese voice path
Known roster names written in Hanzi or multi-syllable Hanyu Pinyin are isolated as Mandarin segments
Pinyin/Hanzi names are never destroyed by a legacy Vietnamese pronunciation replacement before language routing
Prefer an available zh-CN system voice; if absent and Chinese names exist, auto-install/reuse the offline zh_CN-huayan-x_low voice
Single-token Vietnamese names such as LONG are not auto-classified as Chinese solely because the spelling is also a valid Pinyin syllable
Latin Pinyin without tone/character information must not invent lexical tones; PY:/ZH:/VI: dictionary modes allow the operator to lock a reading

features.title: Lightweight camera shuttle replay + optional EdgeOne vision assist
invariants: Camera/WebRTC replay works locally without any AI API key or network AI dependency
Use one MediaRecorder encoder path with short rolling segments; do not run overlapping full-resolution encoders on mobile
Replay captures approximately 6 seconds before and 4 seconds after a marked/candidate event and stores clips locally in IndexedDB
Local detector uses a low-resolution canvas at approximately 8 FPS and must not block scoring, BLV or the live video element
Optional AI sends only 2-4 downscaled still frames, never the full livestream, and is throttled
AI credentials are read only in EdgeOne Functions environment variables and never embedded in frontend HTML/JS
AI endpoint requires a valid Firebase ID token and limits analysis to ADMIN / UMPIRE / LIVE_ONLY roles
AI result is advisory/highlight metadata only and must never mutate score, line call, match winner or umpire state
HLS/YouTube/iframe sources are not promised auto-replay capture because browser CORS/media capture support varies; Camera/WebRTC MediaStream is the supported replay source
Manual replay/tag buttons remain available when AI is unconfigured, offline or returns an error

features.title: Fail-closed live commentary session gate
invariants: Every new website/browser tab starts with commentary audio muted and Auto BLV output closed; voice models may warm silently

Automatic commentary may play only while the foreground/focused browser page is on app tab Umpire or Live and that selected court has an active started match whose match.status is LIVE and whose court status/activeMatchId agree
For non-ADMIN accounts using the Umpire tab, the selected court must still be assigned to the current user via court.umpireUid
The existing Firebase commentary/latest row at gate-arm time is a baseline and must never be replayed as fresh audio in a newly opened tab/session
Only commentary created after the current gate armed and for the current selected court may enter the automatic audio queue

Leaving Umpire/Live, backgrounding/unfocusing the browser tab, deleting/finishing the match, removing the active match, releasing the court, or losing umpire assignment immediately clears the queue and stops Vietnamese Piper, system SpeechSynthesis, Mandarin audio and crowd FX
Multiple browser tabs must not compete for commentary audio; foreground/focus and cross-tab ownership are fail-closed
Manual voice/FX test controls remain explicit operator actions and are not treated as automatic match commentary

features.title: Self-describing upgrade package
invariants: Every release updates TOPKEY_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json
Every new/changed behavior is recorded in CHANGELOG.md and FEATURE_REGISTRY.json
Every release runs REGRESSION_CONTRACT.json tests or records an explicit NOT-RUN reason
Future work must inspect these files before modifying the package

features.title: Origin-root EdgeOne AI endpoint from nested Badminton routes
invariants: Badminton pages under /sports/badminton/ must call the Edge Function at origin-root /api/ai-shuttle-analyze, never ./api/ai-shuttle-analyze
Both AI health GET and vision analysis POST use the same origin-root endpoint
Stable project domains and deployment-specific domains must resolve the AI endpoint without changing frontend code
Environment variables remain server-side; this routing fix must not embed MAKERS_MODELS_KEY in frontend code

features.title: Rear camera default for local court capture
invariants: Every new page session defaults Camera cục bộ to the rear/environment camera, never the selfie/user camera when the browser supports facingMode
Live source UI exposes an explicit Camera sau / Camera trước selector and Camera sau is selected by default
Both local Camera and WebRTC broadcaster use the same selected facingMode constraints
Changing the selector while a local camera stream is active restarts that local stream with the newly selected facing direction
Camera selection changes only media capture and must not change scoring, Firebase match state, AI advisory behavior, replay timing or BLV gates

features.title: Continuous replay playback and longer court context
invariants: New replay target is approximately 10 seconds: about 6 seconds before the marked/candidate event plus 4 seconds after it
Replay recording continues to use exactly one MediaRecorder encoder path; extending replay must not add a second full-resolution encoder on mobile
Multi-segment replay must play the full saved sequence rather than stop after the first short recorder segment

Upgrade85 supersedes MediaSource stitching: independently recorded MediaRecorder files are played one ObjectURL segment at a time, releasing each URL before the next, with a manual Continue fallback if autoplay is blocked
Replay playback/storage changes must never mutate score, winner, court assignment, Firebase match state, BLV gate or EdgeOne AI advisory semantics

features.title: Replay preserves capture orientation and court-size fit
invariants: Each newly recorded replay stores capture orientation metadata from the phone at segment time, including portrait/landscape, screen angle, viewport dimensions and camera track/video dimensions when available
Playback uses the orientation captured when the rally was recorded, not the orientation of the phone later when the replay is opened

If recorded media intrinsic dimensions conflict with the captured portrait/landscape orientation, replay automatically quarter-turns 90 degrees and fits the corrected frame into the stage without the narrow portrait-in-landscape symptom

Landscape court replay uses a 16:9 stage and recalculates fit on resize/orientation changes; a manual 90-degree rotate control remains available for legacy clips or devices with incorrect sensor metadata
Fit/rotate playback changes are visual only and must not mutate replay bytes, score, Firebase match state, AI advisory results, BLV gate, camera-facing selection or MediaRecorder encoder count

features.title: Replay performance guard for long tournament sessions
invariants: Local replay keeps exactly one MediaRecorder encoder and a bounded rolling buffer; performance hardening must not add a second full-resolution encoder.
IndexedDB may retain at most 24 replay clips, while the live JavaScript list materializes only the newest 8 clip records/blobs for the visible replay list.
Pruning old clips uses the createdAt index/key cursor and must not call getAll() merely to discover records to delete.
Replay play/download resolves a missing in-memory item by direct primary-key get, not by loading every stored replay blob.
Detector status UI is change/throttle painted instead of rewriting status innerHTML at the ~8 FPS detector cadence.
Detector grayscale/mask/seen typed arrays are reused between frames to reduce mobile garbage-collection churn.

Leaving Live or backgrounding the browser stops the replay MediaRecorder and detector/frame loops without stopping or mutating score/Firebase match state; returning to foreground Live may restart them.
Object URLs and MediaSource resources remain released when replay closes; local replay storage/performance changes never alter score, BLV gate, AI advisory semantics or camera-facing selection.

features.title: Live-first workspace and automatic Live Focus
invariants: On desktop, Live Viewer, Live Source/Fallback and AI Shuttle Replay share the left workspace column while BLV stays in the right column; controls must use the previously empty area below the Live Viewer instead of forcing long vertical scrolling.
On mobile/tablet the Live workspace becomes one column and replay history is height-bounded/scrollable so accumulated replay cards do not make the page indefinitely tall.
Applying/Open Live Source automatically brings the operator into Live Focus; the viewer fills the visual viewport and may request native fullscreen only from the same user gesture.
Live Focus always exposes an explicit Thu nhỏ control and existing Fit/Fullscreen controls remain recoverable; leaving Live, stopping Live, Escape/back fullscreen exits focus safely.
Live-first layout/focus is presentation/navigation only and must not mutate score, Firebase match state, AI advisory results, replay timing/retention, camera selection or BLV Live Session Gate.

features.title: Disk-first replay metadata + safe lazy playback
invariants: Saved replay video Blobs live in IndexedDB local storage; the live JavaScript replay list keeps metadata only and must not retain saved video Blob arrays.
Opening the website outside Live must not open/read the replay database or materialize old replay video; replay metadata is loaded only when Live is opened.
Pressing Xem fetches exactly the selected replay from IndexedDB on demand; closing the modal revokes the current ObjectURL and releases the full replay record for garbage collection.

Do not append independently recorded MediaRecorder files into MediaSource/SourceBuffer. Multi-segment playback uses one segment ObjectURL at a time, muted by default for safe automatic continuation, with a manual Continue fallback if autoplay is blocked.
Replay recording uses the existing single MediaRecorder path and a video-only MediaStream so court audio encoding does not add unnecessary replay CPU/storage load.
Request persistent browser storage when replay/camera is enabled when supported; storage may still be browser-managed if persistence is not granted.
Legacy Upgrade84 replay records remain on local storage and are migrated to metadata only on explicit operator demand, never during normal startup.

features.title: Startup and observer performance guard
invariants: Default Vietnamese UI must not keep the Upgrade30 whole-body translation MutationObserver active; switching to English/Chinese may enable it and switching back to Vietnamese disables it.
Replay orientation must not use a whole-document MutationObserver; replay click/metadata/resize/orientation events are sufficient.
Overlay-state observation is requestAnimationFrame-coalesced so bursts of DOM mutations cause at most one overlay scan per animation frame.
JSZip and HLS.js are not blocking startup dependencies; load them only when ZIP export or HLS playback is actually requested.
Startup performance changes must not alter scoring, Firebase match state, camera/replay semantics, AI advisory behavior, BLV gate or Live-first layout.

features.title: Durable Live-first layout under lazy Replay creation
invariants: On desktop, the durable order is Live Viewer -> Live Source/Fallback -> AI Shuttle Replay inside #tk84-live-left; BLV remains in the right grid column.
Lazy Replay creation after Live-first layout has already run must immediately re-parent #tk77-replay-card into the left workspace; it must never remain a full-width direct child of #page-live.

The race guard observes only direct children of #page-live and is requestAnimationFrame-coalesced; it must not reintroduce a whole-document/subtree MutationObserver or undo Upgrade85 startup/performance guards.
Entering Live and starting Camera/WebRTC re-check the layout after asynchronous engine startup so later replay/storage changes cannot escape the left workspace.
Layout repair is presentation-only and must not mutate score, Firebase match state, replay Blob storage, AI advisory results, camera selection or BLV gate.

features.title: Natural audience applause with softened offline fallback
invariants: Set/match applause prefers the public-domain natural field recording Applause ii.ogg from Wikimedia/PDSounds when available
Tie applause is OFF by default to avoid repetitive crowd noise; it can be enabled explicitly
Natural crowd media is loaded only from Trọng tài/Live interaction and runtime-cached when the browser permits, so normal app startup is not slowed by the remote audio
Existing local tie/set/match OGG assets remain offline fallback and are softened/lower-level rather than removed
Crowd FX never owns or reuses the Piper commentary audio element

features.title: Vietnamese male/female commentary voice profile
invariants: BLV UI exposes Auto, Nam and Nữ voice profiles without changing score/commentary generation

Nam profile prefers a vi-VN system voice whose name is identifiable as male; when no male-labeled vi-VN system voice exists it uses the nearest allowed vi-VN system voice with a lower pitch and reports that fallback honestly
Exact voice chosen manually in the existing vi-VN voice selector takes precedence over profile heuristics
Upgrade87 does not download or select the Piper 25hours_single model because its production/source license is not established in this package
Existing vais1000 Piper voice remains the offline fallback when no usable system voice exists

features.title: Auto-first BLV audio with truthful button states
invariants: Auto BLV userEnabled defaults to true; Live Session Gate still decides whether a commentary event may speak
On the first user gesture in Trọng tài/Live, TOPKEY automatically attempts the existing verified audio-unlock path; manual activation is only actionable when the browser blocks it

When audio is verified and active, activation buttons are disabled/dimmed and display an ON state; when waiting for a valid LIVE session they are disabled/dimmed and display ARMED; only a blocked browser state is bright/actionable
No stale commentary may bypass Upgrade78 Live Session Gate just because audio is primed

features.title: Referee reset scope chooser
invariants: The referee Reset button opens a two-choice radio/tick menu: current set or whole match
Current-set reset delegates to the existing App.resetSet flow so current scoring/opening-server/audit contracts remain authoritative
Whole-match reset is ADMIN-only and delegates to Upgrade68 resetMatchResult with SCHEDULED target and post-write verification
Whole-match reset clears result/sets/winner/finishedAt and active scoring state, returns court AVAILABLE, and preserves teams/players/schedule record
Upgrade87 does not introduce a competing direct Firebase score/reset write path

features.title: Viewer-first Live player with shared-camera WebRTC
invariants: Public spectator places Trận đang Live and the viewing stage before schedule/standings; HLS/YouTube may play publicly without login when configured.
Local Camera capture remains one camera stream; Upgrade88 reuses that exact stream for authenticated WebRTC viewers and must not call getUserMedia a second time.
VIEWER/LIVE_ONLY accounts land on the Live player and receive CAMERA/WEBRTC from the broadcaster; they must never open their own local camera as the remote source.
WebRTC signaling remains authenticated under existing Firebase rules; unauthenticated public spectator must show an honest login requirement instead of opening public signaling writes.
Viewer mode hides broadcaster/source/replay/BLV controls while preserving fullscreen/player controls; viewer actions must not mutate score or match state.
VIEWER/LIVE_ONLY playback quiesces AI Replay recorder/detector loops on the remote stream so watching Live does not consume replay/AI CPU or local replay storage.

features.title: UMPIRE scoring ownership matches BLV Session Gate
invariants: Upgrade78 assignment gate remains authoritative: a non-ADMIN UMPIRE may speak only for the court assigned to that UID.
When an UMPIRE starts/scores a court that has no umpireUid, Upgrade88 self-assigns that court to the current UID through the normal court Firebase path and audit before commentary is evaluated.
If a court is already assigned to another UID, Upgrade88 does not bypass the gate and does not silently take ownership.
After self-claim/start, Upgrade78 is re-evaluated and Upgrade87 audio-state UI is synchronized so the score gesture can prime/unlock audio and speak the new score event.
Upgrade88 does not write activeMatches/matches for audio ownership; scoring remains owned by the existing referee pipeline.

features.title: Public Viewer no-login + stable client shell
invariants: #spectator never renders the login form
F5 preserves #spectator and restores anonymous signaling auth
Legacy Service Worker/cache can be cleared without clearing Piper/crowd runtime caches
Only the current final stability authority may define the visible runtime version
Spectator Firebase listeners are installed once per page session

features.title: Public Viewer renders before Auth; reset clears all same-origin TOPKEY SW/cache
invariants: #spectator first paint must show public-spectator even if Firebase/Auth is unavailable
Anonymous Auth runs in background and never gates public UI
Final authority must not observe and rewrite its own build attribute recursively
reset-u93 provides a visible manual Viewer link

features.title: Public Viewer BLV audio follows visible audio gesture and selected court
invariants: The visible Public Viewer #tk88-public-unmute gesture enables both Live audio and Viewer-local BLV TTS.
Viewer commentary binds to the court actually selected by Upgrade88 public Live, not a hard-coded/default court.
Firebase commentary/latest is primary; activeMatches score changes provide a delayed local fallback when commentary is late or missing.
Viewer BLV does not mutate score/match state and does not require a second camera/microphone stream.

features.title: Performance-safe bundle/cache consolidation
invariants: Upgrade94 behavior sources and exact execution order remain preserved inside the U95 JS bundle
Browser loads one local CSS bundle and one application JS bundle plus the SW preboot helper
Firebase/QRCode CDN scripts do not block HEAD parsing
Service Worker precaches only the minimal app shell plus three local applause assets; legacy source/tests remain auditable but are not precached
Content-hashed U95 JS/CSS are cache-first; HTML/build/sw remain fresh
Firebase Rules, TURN config, TURN credential Edge Function, scoring and WebRTC protocol remain unchanged; later Viewer BLV lifecycle fixes may update U94 source under regression protection

features.title: Viewer BLV lifecycle isolation and stale snapshot suppression
invariants: Viewer audio enable never flips App.audioUnlocked, so legacy BTC Local BLV cannot be activated by a public Viewer gesture.
The initial Firebase commentary/latest value on bind/rebind is baselined and never spoken.
Commentary dedupe is per court, preventing old rows from replaying when selected court changes or listeners rebind.
Only a fresh commentary key after the baseline may speak; activeMatches 700 ms fallback remains unchanged.
Public Viewer does not use native requestFullscreen for its large-view control
Entering #spectator releases stale screen.orientation locks
Public Viewer never locks landscape
Umpire Match Focus and Replay orientation controllers are unchanged
features.note: Historical CSS-only portrait-safe guard. Upgrade98 supersedes final Viewer behavior by user request: explicit Xem ngang uses native fullscreen + landscape and portrait-track correction.

features.title: Viewer landscape Live + phone referee readability
invariants: Viewer remains public/no-login and opens no camera or microphone.
Only an explicit Viewer Xem ngang gesture requests native fullscreen and best-effort landscape orientation.
A portrait-sized WebRTC video track is auto-rotated 90 degrees in horizontal Viewer mode, with a manual reverse/straighten control.
Exiting Viewer fullscreen unlocks orientation.
Short-landscape referee fullscreen uses larger score/name/action typography and at least 44px primary touch targets.
Scoring, Firebase Rules, TURN, WebRTC signaling and BLV lifecycle are unchanged.

features.title: Public Viewer one-shot landscape patch lifecycle
invariants: No recursive MutationObserver patch loop on public-spectator
Observer disconnects before any fullscreen button text/class mutation
Viewer render/Firebase callbacks remain schedulable
Upgrade98 landscape and referee readability behavior remains available

features.title: WebRTC broadcaster heartbeat, self-heal and waiting-session preservation
invariants: Broadcaster must never delete fresh Viewer requests when it reloads/self-heals
Existing waiting Viewer sessions receive an offer when broadcaster attaches
Live local camera periodically writes broadcaster heartbeat
Viewer retries signaling once when broadcaster is fresh but offer is delayed
Viewer reports stale/offline broadcaster quickly instead of waiting indefinitely

features.title: Incremental Firebase listeners, tab scoping and render coalescing
invariants: Core operational branches remain live for scoring/schedule ownership
Finance, audit, registrations, commentary and users listeners attach only on relevant authenticated tabs and detach on tab change
Public Viewer does not subscribe to the whole commentary tree; BLV follows only commentary/<selectedCourt>/latest
Upgrade94 duplicate global Viewer listeners are suppressed while its per-court commentary listener and 700 ms fallback remain active
Burst child updates are coalesced into one render frame instead of one full render per Firebase callback
Firebase Rules, TURN, WebRTC signaling, scoring, BLV lifecycle and Viewer orientation behavior are unchanged

features.title: Active-tab rendering, background render deferral and runtime latency metrics
invariants: Firebase state updates continue even when a branch page is hidden
Authenticated DOM rendering is limited to the active tab; hidden Overview KPI rendering is skipped
When the document is hidden, admin DOM rendering is deferred and flushed once on return
Upgrade90 legacy Viewer BLV poller retires when Upgrade94 is installed
Upgrade94 Viewer BLV court binding is event-driven without continuous 700 ms polling
Passive latency instrumentation does not change scoring or Firebase persistence semantics
Firebase Rules, TURN, WebRTC signaling, BLV lifecycle and Viewer orientation behavior remain unchanged

features.title: Direct-first Firebase score persistence
invariants: Referee score UI remains optimistic/local-first
Online authenticated SCORE writes bypass the general IndexedDB backlog and use one atomic Firebase multi-location update
If direct SCORE write fails or the court already has queued SCORE writes, persist safely to IndexedDB in order
Permission-denied SCORE writes become BLOCKED and surface an error instead of retrying forever
Non-SCORE queue behavior is unchanged

features.title: Collapsible schedule panels
invariants: Public schedule can collapse/expand without changing schedule or standings data
Admin schedule list can collapse/expand without changing schedule data
Collapse state persists per browser
Search/filter/live/standings behavior is unchanged

features.title: Bounded schedule internal scroll
invariants: Expanded Admin schedule uses its own bounded vertical scrollbar
Expanded Public schedule uses its own bounded vertical scrollbar
Table header remains sticky while schedule scrolls
Schedule collapse/expand and persisted state from Upgrade105 remain authoritative
No scoring/Firebase/WebRTC/BLV semantics are changed

features.title: Schedule DOM parent safety after collapse/scroll wrappers
invariants: Re-rendering schedule/status after U105/U106 wrappers must not call insertBefore with a reference node owned by another parent
Admin and public search bars are inserted relative to the actual parent of the schedule/table reference
Changing match status must not be blocked by schedule UX DOM structure

features.title: Hashed asset cache correctness
invariants: Current build JS/CSS must be precached by the Service Worker
Hashed app assets use cache-first independent of upgrade number
HTML/build.json/sw.js/reset pages remain network-first/no-cache
EdgeOne immutable headers use wildcard asset paths so future hashed bundles do not need per-version header edits

features.title: Route-gated minimal public Viewer boot
invariants: #spectator must not load Admin application bundle
Viewer loads Firebase App/Auth/Database but not Firebase Storage or QRCode
Public Viewer retains schedule, standings, announcement, WebRTC/TURN, BLV and fullscreen/rotation
Protected non-spectator route retains full Admin bundle

features.title: Admin login dynamic boot guard
invariants: Admin boot runs exactly once whether bundle loads before or after DOMContentLoaded
Login form cannot native-GET submit before Firebase login handler is attached
email/password query parameters are removed from URL/history immediately
Viewer minimal boot remains route-isolated

features.title: Safe admin feature code splitting
invariants: Viewer Minimal Boot remains isolated from Admin
Admin login boot must not load Firebase Storage, QRCode, JSZip or Replay/AI chunk
Replay/AI chunk loads on first Live tab entry
Firebase Storage loads only on finance/settings/upload demand
QRCode loads only on Teams/registration demand
Feature loading must not change scoring, Rules, TURN, WebRTC signaling or BLV semantics

features.title: Viewer Firebase Window
invariants: Viewer schedule uses bounded date queries instead of a full matches listener
Standings use completed-status queries so BXH remains complete
Teams are subscribed on demand by referenced team id
Announcements subscribe only to the latest item
matches/date,status and announcements/createdAt are indexed without changing write permissions

features.title: Atomic score + event + commentary Firebase update
invariants: Positive score actions keep local optimistic UI and local BLV immediate
activeMatches + score event + commentary/latest are merged into one SCORE Firebase update when commentary is generated
Score correction without commentary is not delayed
Offline/permission fallback remains owned by Upgrade105 Fast Lane queue semantics

features.title: Admin runtime consolidation phase 1
invariants: Public Viewer legacy upgrades 92-100 are not executed inside Admin core after Viewer Minimal Boot owns public Viewer behavior
Referee landscape CSS from Upgrade98 remains in Admin CSS
WebRTC broadcaster Upgrade101 remains in Admin runtime
A single final runtime authority owns Upgrade114 version/server status after legacy timers settle
Legacy source files remain packaged for audit/regression but need not execute at runtime

features.title: Admin data/runtime consolidation phase 2
invariants: Upgrade102 and Upgrade103 legacy source files remain packaged for audit but are not executed in Admin core
One core/data-runtime.js owns tab-scoped listeners, render coalescing, visibility defer/cache render and latency metrics
Compatibility exports TopkeyUpgrade102 and TopkeyUpgrade103 remain available for Fast Lane/Health contracts
Firebase paths, scoring semantics, Rules, TURN, WebRTC and Viewer bundle are unchanged
Admin showTab data/runtime wrapper count is reduced from two legacy wrappers to one consolidated wrapper

features.title: Schedule / Umpire / Live feature boundaries
invariants: One core UI boundary owns the shared Admin showTab/renderMatches/renderSpectator dispatch points for migrated features
Legacy Upgrade80/106/107 source remains packaged for audit but does not execute in Admin core
Schedule internal scroll and DOM-parent repair are owned by features/schedule/runtime.js
Umpire top reset is owned by features/umpire/runtime.js while Upgrade24 search behavior remains intact
Rear/front camera selection is owned by features/live/runtime.js with Upgrade80 compatibility export
Upgrade24, Upgrade87 and Upgrade111 migrated hooks register with the boundary and retain fallback behavior

features.title: Production boot/queue single-flight hardening
invariants: Data.init and Auth.init cannot install duplicate long-lived listeners when boot is invoked repeatedly
Only one underlying Firebase/IndexedDB flushQueue drain may run at a time
Concurrent connection/online/action flush triggers are coalesced without dropping retryBlocked/focus semantics
Resume/visible/online recovery triggers coalesce and only flush when Data/Auth are ready
Health exposes hardening counters, queue high-water and listener-budget self-check

features.title: Long-session leak / scoring soak contract
invariants: 100 repeated subscriptions leave exactly one owned core listener set
1200 tab changes do not multiply UI boundary hooks or dynamic Firebase listeners
500 awarded points with commentary produce exactly 500 underlying atomic writes and leave no atomic pending entries
Existing WebRTC heartbeat/self-heal, Viewer BLV and offline Fast Lane regression tests remain mandatory

features.title: Production artifact cleanup and dependency hygiene
invariants: Replay/AI lazy loader resolves current feature assets from runtime asset manifest and never hardcodes an older versioned asset directory
Production package contains only the current versioned asset directory plus shared audio while source/tests/history remain available
Hashed current assets remain immutable and Service Worker precaches only current Viewer shell
No Firebase Rules, scoring, TURN, WebRTC, BLV or Viewer data-path changes
